jobs.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.jd:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. Deshalb fördern wir ein offenes, respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jede Person unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder individuellen Lebenswegen entfalten kann. Unsere Unternehmenskultur zeichnet sich durch Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und einen starken Teamgeist aus. Wir bieten Dir die Flexibilität, Beruf- und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen, und schaffen Raum für persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die digitale Zukunft – und dabei zählt jede Meinung.


Darum geht's:

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass der Applikationsbetrieb (On-Premises, Cloud) unserer Software bei den Kund*innen reibungslos läuft
  • Dabei übernimmst Du den Support, die Administration und die Konfiguration der Lovion BIS Software
  • Software-Aktualisierungen sowie System- und Programmtests zur Qualitätssicherung werden von Dir durchgeführt
  • Zudem unterstützt Du den 1st-Level-Support bei IT-anwendungsrelevanten Fragen
  • Du übernimmst die Kommunikation zwischen unseren Kund*innen und den internen Teams bei Fehlerbehebungen und neuen Anforderungen
  • Das Customizing und Datenmodellanpassungen der Lovion BIS Software gehören ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich (Geo-)Informatik, eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrungen im Applikationsbetrieb einer Software-Lösung bringst Du idealerweise bereits mit
  • Kenntnisse in objektorientierter Programmierung, wie z.B. C#, sind wünschenswert

jobs.jd:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.
